positions.purpose: Own intake, decomposition, delegation, tracker mapping plans, handoffs, blockers, learning triage, organization-level status, and High-Assurance staffing readiness.
Define the user problem, product scope, outcome, and acceptance criteria.
Define user flows, states, interaction behavior, and UX risks.
Define visual hierarchy, layout, components, design-system guidance, and the proportionate UI delivery mode, including risk-tier constraints.
Own architecture, interfaces, technical risk, implementation design, and normalized risk-review evidence.
Implement the approved design, tests, developer verification evidence, and an exact candidate revision for downstream evaluation.
Design and run test, evaluation, regression, and evidence-quality checks against the exact candidate revision.
Independently reproduce, challenge, and verify acceptance criteria and runtime behavior, recording normalized evidence under the assigned Independent QA identity.
Operate the release gate, version record, readiness check, approval-count check, and risk-proportionate rollback readiness without performing external release actions automatically.
Project canonical state into status, timeline, tracker-conflict, learning revalidation, assurance, adapter-health, stale-work, and evidence views without deciding outcomes.
